html:
G'oya

Ikki vaqt orasidagi farqni soniyalarda olamiz, chunki soniyalar oddiy son va ularni bemalol o'rtachalash mumkin. Operator bo'yicha o'rtachani topib, 3600 ga bo'lamiz va oxirida yaxlitlaymiz. Yopilmagan murojaatlar WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL da guruhlashdan oldin tushib qoladi, faqat ochiq murojaatlari bor operator esa shu bilan natijadan ham chiqadi.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da ikki TIMESTAMP ning ayirmasi INTERVAL, masalan 18:00:00 yoki 2 days 06:30:00. EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ...) uni soniyalarga aylantiradi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT operator,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM closed_at - created_at)) / 3600, 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY operator

SQLite'da vaqtlar matn, ularni unixepoch soniyalarga aylantiradi. 3600.0 kasr bilan yozilgan, aks holda butun sonlar bo'linib kasr qismi yo'qoladi:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT operator,
       ROUND(AVG(unixepoch(closed_at) - unixepoch(created_at)) / 3600.0, 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY operator

Namunada Aziz ikki murojaatni 2.5 va 0.75 soatda yopgan: o'rtacha 1.625, yaxlitlangani 1.6.

Tuzoqlar

PostgreSQL'da EXTRACT(HOUR FROM closed_at - created_at) intervalning faqat soat qismini beradi. 2 days 06:30:00 uchun bu 6: kunlar ham, 30 daqiqa ham yo'qoladi.

Avval har murojaatni yaxlitlab, keyin o'rtacha olish boshqa son beradi. Azizda 2.5 va 0.8 ning o'rtachasi 1.65, yaxlitlangani 1.7, to'g'ri javob esa 1.6:

Noto'g'riSELECT operator,
       ROUND(AVG(ROUND((unixepoch(closed_at) - unixepoch(created_at)) / 3600.0, 1)), 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY operator

O'rtachani SUM / COUNT(*) bilan qo'lda hisoblasangiz, COUNT(*) yopilmagan murojaatlarni ham sanaydi. AVG esa NULL larni o'zi tashlab yuboradi.

WHERE siz Bekzod natijada NULL bilan qoladi, shart esa uni umuman ko'rsatmaslikni talab qiladi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da intervallarning o'zini ham o'rtachalash mumkin: AVG(closed_at - created_at) o'rtacha intervalni beradi, uni keyin soniyalarga aylantiramiz. AVG NULL intervallarni tashlab yuboradi, HAVING esa faqat ochiq murojaatlari bor operatorni olib tashlaydi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT operator,
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(closed_at - created_at)) / 3600, 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY operator
HAVING COUNT(closed_at) > 0

SQLite'da julianday ham ishlaydi: ayirma kunlarda, uni 24 ga ko'paytirsangiz soat chiqadi.
